clue.text: Passing time day to day

parts.note: the hour at which one calendar day hands over to the next, read as a time of passing

explanation.definitionFit: Twelve o'clock at night is the moment one date ends and the following one begins.

clue.text: In splitting up atom you are so to speak creating a monster

indicators.note: the word In goes between the letters of the shuffled atom, splitting them apart
broken up, so the letters of atom are rearranged
spoken, the phrase you are sounds like two letters

parts.note: said aloud, you are sounds like the letters U and R

explanation.surface: A nuclear physicist splitting the atom unleashes something monstrous.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' shuffles the atom into MOTA before IN splits it. Text-speak writes 'you are' as two letters, which 'so to speak' signals.
explanation.definitionFit: The Minotaur of Greek myth was a bull-headed beast kept in the Cretan labyrinth.

clue.text: Guard seen changing overalls

indicators.note: changing signals that the letters of guard and seen are rearranged

explanation.surface: A sentry is spotted swapping into work clothes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'changing' rearranges the letters of GUARD and SEEN.
explanation.definitionFit: Dungarees are bib-fronted work trousers, a kind of protective one-piece garment.

clue.text: Half Piccadilly in chaos — the work of linesman

indicators.note: in chaos says the kept letters are jumbled into a new order
only half of the word Piccadilly is kept, its second five letters

explanation.surface: Part of a busy London street is in chaos, as a railway worker might report.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Half' keeps DILLY, the back half of PICCADILLY (a busy London street), and 'in chaos' rearranges it. The linesman is a writer of lines of verse, not a railway or football official.
explanation.definitionFit: A short pastoral poem is something a poet, who writes in lines, produces.

clue.text: Capital cigars

parts.note: smokes named after the Cuban capital, with capital also meaning first-rate

explanation.definitionFit: Fine cigars made in Cuba take the name of its chief city.

clue.text: Sounds like a joker freed from attention

definitions.meaning: spoken, the two words sound just like a phrase for a prankster
the relaxed drill stance a soldier takes when released from standing rigidly upright

explanation.surface: Something resembling a prankster has been released from the parade-ground order.
explanation.walkthrough: Attention is the parade-ground position; the command that relaxes it is the second definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The soldier's relaxed stance follows release from standing rigidly upright on parade.

clue.text: One who can adjudicate between Indians and Chinese

definitions.text: One who can adjudicate between Indians and Chinese

parts.words: One who can adjudicate between Indians and Chinese
parts.note: Indian and China are kinds of leaf brew, and a professional judge of them compares the two

explanation.definitionFit: A professional sampler grades brews such as Assam and Lapsang for quality.

clue.text: Home is the sailor with a song

parts.note: AB, able-bodied seaman, is a standard sailor abbreviation
an ode is a lyric poem meant to be sung

explanation.surface: A seaman back from voyage sings at his house.
explanation.definitionFit: A dwelling place, a residence.

clue.text: Four-day holiday controlled by notional satellite

definitions.text: Four-day holiday controlled by notional satellite

parts.words: Four-day holiday controlled by notional satellite
parts.note: a long weekend from Friday to Monday whose date is fixed by a calculated church moon, not the real one

explanation.walkthrough: The ecclesiastical full moon used to date this festival is a computed, notional one, not the actual moon.
explanation.definitionFit: The Christian spring festival runs Good Friday to Monday, dated from a paschal full moon.

clue.text: Sheila ordered to make a profit we hear

indicators.note: the letters of Sheila are put in a different order

explanation.surface: A woman is told to go and make money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ordered' rearranges SHEILA. The definition is itself spoken: 'a profit, we hear' is 'a prophet', and Elisha was an Old Testament prophet.
explanation.definitionFit: Elisha was the Hebrew seer who succeeded Elijah, so a soundalike of profit names his calling.

clue.text: French city girl

definitions.meaning: a city in Lorraine, eastern France

explanation.definitionFit: Both the capital of historic Lorraine and a common female forename share this spelling.

clue.text: Book boats to view some mountains

parts.note: VOL is the abbreviation for volume, a book
canoes are small paddled boats

explanation.surface: Someone reserves boats for a scenic trip among peaks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Book' looks like a verb meaning reserve, but it is the noun volume.
explanation.definitionFit: Peaks formed by eruption of lava are a subset of hills and peaks.

clue.text: Immovable principles in some courts

definitions.meaning: fixed rules one cannot deviate from, like rails a tram must follow
the parallel side lines marked on tennis courts

explanation.definitionFit: Rigid habits of thought follow fixed tracks; tennis courts carry those doubles side lines too.

clue.text: First victim to East Poplar

parts.note: Abel, killed by Cain, is the Bible's first murder victim
E is the compass abbreviation for east

explanation.surface: The first murdered man is taken to a district of east London.
explanation.walkthrough: Poplar looks like the London district, but it is the tree.
explanation.definitionFit: The white poplar tree is also called by this old name.

clue.text: Futile way to economize

definitions.meaning: consume a smaller amount, read as a two-word phrase

explanation.definitionFit: Something pointless is of no service; split in two, the letters tell you to consume less.

clue.text: Subterranean flight controller?

parts.note: a flight of stairs below ground that is mechanically driven, as on the London Underground

explanation.definitionFit: A moving staircase in a tube station carries passengers up and down a stair flight.

clue.text: Course shows where to find tee?

definitions.meaning: a dish in a meal, here the pudding
the letter tee sits next ... in the alphabet, read as two words

explanation.definitionFit: The sweet dish is British slang for dessert; split, it says T follows S.

clue.text: Regard one as sort of music maker

indicators.note: sort of signals that regard and one are sorted into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Someone thinks of a person as a kind of musician.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sort of' rearranges the letters of REGARD and ONE.
explanation.definitionFit: A harmonium-type keyboard instrument sounds notes through vibrating free reeds.

clue.text: Impulsive action of many impressed the point

parts.note: stamped means marked by pressing
E, east, is one of the points of the compass

explanation.surface: A crowd rushing makes its mark on the issue.
explanation.definitionFit: A sudden mass rush of panicking animals or people is a headlong flight.

clue.text: Bowman's love is kept in mind

definitions.meaning: the archer god Cupid fell for a mortal girl of Greek myth

explanation.definitionFit: Cupid's beloved in myth shares her name with the Greek word for soul, the human spirit.

clue.text: Eastern loch side, perhaps

parts.note: Loch Leven is a Scottish lake

explanation.surface: The eastern shore of a Scottish lake, possibly.
explanation.walkthrough: LEVEN is a well-known Scottish loch. Side is a sports team, which in football or cricket has this many players.
explanation.definitionFit: A football or cricket team fields this number of players.

clue.text: Left net smash to prodigy

parts.note: port is the left side of a ship

indicators.note: smash breaks the word net and rearranges it

explanation.surface: A tennis player leaves the net to hit a winning smash.
explanation.walkthrough: 'smash' rearranges NET into ENT. Prodigy here is an omen, a marvel foretelling something.
explanation.definitionFit: An omen or marvellous sign was once called a prodigy.

clue.text: Country girl not quite up to examination

parts.note: Peru is a South American country

indicators.note: the girl's name is cut short, its ending dropped

parts.note: Sally is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A country lass is not quite ready for a test.
explanation.definitionFit: A careful reading through of a text is a scrutiny of it.

clue.text: Spinner gives potter a rest

definitions.meaning: a snooker player, who pots balls, uses this raised cue rest

explanation.walkthrough: In snooker a potter is a player, and this is a long-legged rest for the cue over other balls.
explanation.definitionFit: The web-spinning arachnid lends its name to a high-legged snooker cue rest.

clue.text: She and her mother are from Neptune's Kingdom

definitions.text: She and her mother are from Neptune's Kingdom

parts.words: She and her mother are from Neptune's Kingdom
parts.note: a gem and its nacre parent both come from the sea, ruled by Neptune

explanation.walkthrough: Mother here is the shell lining, mother-of-pearl; She is also a girl's name.
explanation.definitionFit: The oyster gem and its iridescent shell lining are both sea products.

clue.text: Kind of education Peter Pan could never have

definitions.text: Kind of education Peter Pan could never have

parts.words: Kind of education Peter Pan could never have
parts.note: evening classes for grown-ups, which the boy who never grew up could not join

explanation.definitionFit: Continuing classes for grown-ups suit only those who have grown up.

clue.text: Underground ventilator?

parts.note: a burrowing creature that lets air into the soil

explanation.definitionFit: Burrowing annelids aerate the soil with their tunnels.

clue.text: Deliver, remove: and remain suspended

indicators.note: remove tells you to take the following word out of the phrase for deliver

parts.note: to deliver is to hand over
the word and is the letters removed

explanation.surface: A pilot is told to drop off a load and then stay aloft.
explanation.walkthrough: 'remove' takes AND out of HAND OVER (to deliver), leaving H OVER.
explanation.definitionFit: To stay floating in the air without moving is to hang there.

clue.text: Surely oldest bus needs reconditioning?

indicators.note: reconditioning remakes, so the letters of oldest and bus are rebuilt in a new order

explanation.surface: The most ancient coach in the fleet must surely be overhauled.
explanation.walkthrough: 'needs reconditioning' rearranges the letters of OLDEST and BUS.
explanation.definitionFit: Certainly, without question.

clue.text: Geneva guest not wholly dim

indicators.note: only part of the words Geneva guest is used, a run inside them

explanation.surface: A visitor from Switzerland is a bit slow.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not wholly' picks a run from inside GENEVA GUEST.
explanation.definitionFit: Indistinct or hazy, unclear.

clue.text: Preservative put in colour to slow down the action

indicators.note: put in places the preservative inside the colour

parts.note: red is a colour
tar is used to preserve wood and rope

explanation.surface: A wood preservative is mixed into paint to slow its drying.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface pictures paint drying slowly; the definition is the verb to slow, with 'to' a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To delay or hold back progress.

clue.text: Carriage becoming William IV?

definitions.meaning: before taking the throne William IV was Duke of this title

explanation.walkthrough: 'becoming' joins the two: the carriage was named after William IV when he was a duke.
explanation.definitionFit: A closed four-wheeled coach shares its name with William IV's dukedom before he was king.
